message.reasoning_content: "If You've Got Trouble" – Ringo lead vocal only. "She Came In Through the Bathroom Window" also Ringo? No, that's McCartney. Ringo sings "Circles"? "Circles" is a Harrison demo... Ringo sang "Circles" on Ringo's? Actually Ringo covered it. But Anthology "If You've Got Trouble" is Ringo's.
